bib.title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model

question: Can continuous sensor inputs be injected into a pretrained LLM's embedding space so one model handles embodied reasoning, vision-language and language tasks with positive transfer?
hypothesis: Joint training on diverse internet-scale and embodied data transfers across tasks and embodiments, and larger LLMs forget less when trained multimodally.
contributions: Generalist, transfer-learned, multi-embodiment decision-making agent trained by mixing embodied data into multimodal LLM training
Show off-the-shelf VLMs do not solve embodied reasoning zero-shot but a general VLM can also be an efficient embodied reasoner
Novel architectural ideas: neural scene representations (OSRT) and entity-labeling multimodal tokens
PaLM-E is a quantitatively competent vision and language generalist
Scaling the LLM gives less catastrophic forgetting in multimodal finetuning

method.summary: Encoders (state MLP, ViT, ViT+TokenLearner, OSRT) map observations to sequences of vectors in the PaLM token embedding space, interleaved with text embeddings as multimodal sentences; the decoder-only LLM is trained with cross-entropy on text targets, with the LLM frozen or unfrozen. Evaluated on TAMP, Language-Table and mobile manipulation plus VQA, captioning and language tasks.
method.task: embodied planning / multimodal next-token prediction (VQA, captioning, planning)

datasets.name: Full mixture (Table 6)
datasets.source: WebLI 52.4%, VQ2A 13.1%, VQG 5.2%, CC3M 13.1%, Object Aware 5.2%, OKVQA 0.5%, VQAv2 0.5%, COCO 0.5%, Wikipedia text 0.5%, mobile manipulator (real) 3.1%, Language Table sim and real 4.2%, TAMP sim 1.6%

datasets.name: TAMP (simulated)
datasets.size: 96,000 training scenes (3-5 objects); 1% = 320 examples per planning task
datasets.split: test also 6 and 8 objects and OOD tasks

datasets.name: Language-Table (Lynch et al. 2022)
datasets.size: 10 to 80 demos per task in few-shot sweeps
datasets.split: Task 1 test set accuracy; Tasks 2,3 80 rollouts each
datasets.preprocessing: labeler enters a short-horizon command every 4 s; policy executes 40 steps (10Hz)

datasets.name: OK-VQA, VQAv2, COCO (Karpathy)
datasets.split: OK-VQA val; VQAv2 test-dev/test-std; COCO Karpathy test

models.name: PaLM-E-12B
models.init_from: PaLM 8B, ViT-4B pretrained on image classification

other.use: zero-shot, not trained on robot data

training.objective: cross-entropy over the non-prefix text tokens of multimodal sentences
training.steps: Language-Table finetuned variants: pretrained PaLM-E trained 9,000 additional steps; otherwise None

other.freezing: LLM frozen (only encoder/projector trained) or whole model trained; for OSRT only projector psi trained
other.encoders: ViT-4B, ViT-22B pretrained; ViT+TokenLearner and state MLP trained from scratch; OSRT trained on novel-view synthesis

inference.samples: Language-Table sim Tasks 2,3: 80 rollouts per task; other runs and seeds not stated
inference.prompting: Multimodal sentences such as 'Given . Q: ... A:'; mobile manipulation 'Human: Robot: . I see .'; object-centric prefix 'Obj 1 is . ...'

parameters.control_loop: PaLM-E outputs language subgoals at 1 Hz; Language-Table policies output actions at 5 Hz (main text); appendix says policy executes 40 steps (10Hz for 4 seconds)
parameters.replan_interval: new instruction every 4 s in Language-Table

metrics.name: relative drop in NLG/NLU average vs PaLM

eval.protocol: No seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests reported; real-robot results qualitative
